description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature reduces you to half your maximum Hit Points or fewer, or scores a critical hit against you.

Gain a +1 status bonus to your next attack roll or Rite spell attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn. You don't have to have the last word. You just usually do.
